description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 144 (Vavuniya) Awaranthulawa D/S Division, Valuniya South (Sinhalese), Vavuniya District - Block Survey Village Plan No. 112 (North)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement matters under the Land Settlement Ordinance. It contains final orders for land settlements in specific locations (Vavuniya and Nuwara Eliya districts), detailing lot numbers, extents, and settlement status (primarily to "The State"). The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters present.
